text:
anya: NimbusCompute reached out — they want a joint perf/W + throughput benchmark for their NC-Edge module. Target audience: marketplace buyers and SI partners. Can we scope a minimal reproducible sweep?
tom: short answer: yes. suggest models: distil-gpt2, gpt-neo-125M, and a trimmed llama2-7b (pruned for edge). seqs: 128 and 1024. bs: 1,2. conc: 1,2,4. keep runs under 2 hours total.
li: add both 'stock' kernel and "nimbus-rt" tuned kernel. need to capture power rails + board-level thermals. Nimbus will share per-board INA readings but wants raw CSVs private.
nancy: (product) we need a 1-paragraph line for the marketplace tile, plus a small chart (throughput vs watts). embargo until joint blog.
cass: bench-bot here 4bb I created template job: `job/nimbus-edge-bench-2024-07`. Config summary: `models:[distilgpt2,gptneo-125m,llama2-7b-trim] seq:[128,1024] bs:[1,2] concurrency:[1,2,4] power_log:/artifacts/nimbus/$JOB_ID/power.csv`
tom: can bench support toggling kernel flags so we run A/B? need `--kernel=stock` and `--kernel=nimbus-rt` toggle.
cass: yes. template supports `kernel_variant` and will emit separate artifact folders. also added `--sample-ms=100` for tail power.
li: legal: Nimbus requires we sign an addendum allowing kernel tuning to be listed in benchmark notes. @legal-bot any blockers?
legal-bot: flagged. please attach proposed wording to RED-789. NDA addendum reviewed; legal needs partner signature before public materials.
anya: blockers: (1) signed addendum (2) partner asset pack (logo + quote) (3) infra creds for partner to pull aggregated charts (not raw CSVs).
tom: infra can provide pre-signed URLs and a read-only bucket with aggregated PNGs/CSV-summaries only. I'll do that Mon morning.
li: reproducibility: include prompt seed file and retokenization hash. append an `appendix.md` to artifacts with commands used.
anya: timeline: dry-run Mon, full sweep Tue. deliverable: perf card + partner-approved blurb by Wed EOD.
cass: bench-bot scheduled job/nimbus-edge-bench-2024-07 for 2024-07-09T08:00:00Z. logs -> /artifacts/nimbus/job-nimbus-edge-bench-2024-07/logs
anya: great. tagging RED-789 and setting sync Mon 09:00. will post draft marketplace blurb here once ready.
